description: `-e count=null` JSON-sniffs to Python None, which `check_interface_inputs` treats as absent -- an input value that is absent or None gets its declared `default:` filled in (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §1.5). `count`'s declared type is `number`, not `string`, so raw-text restoration never applies here (contrast e-coercion-string-numeric, where it does).
